acceptance_criteria: Cycle-accurate simulation matches the reference FIFO model for all sequences of writes, reads, simultaneous operations, overflow attempts, and underflow attempts over 1000 cycles.
The submitted module compiles with iverilog without errors.
The submitted module synthesizes with yosys without errors.
hidden_spec.ground_truth: The design is a depth-4, width-8 FIFO with two-bit write and read pointers, a 3-bit occupancy counter, and registered read data output. Full flag is occupancy == 4, empty flag is occupancy == 0. Write increments write pointer and occupancy when write_en and not full. Read increments read pointer and decrements occupancy when read_en and not empty. read_data is the output of a register that samples the RAM output at the read pointer address.

security_requirements.requirement: The submitted artifact satisfies the hidden domain-specific security property.

hidden_spec.threat_model: Flattening hides storage boundaries and timing semantics needed to integrate or audit an undocumented queue.

constraints: The input netlist is a flattened gate-level description using DFFs and multiplexers.
The design uses a synchronous active-high reset.
The FIFO depth is 4 and width is 8 bits.
The submission must be a single Verilog file with no external dependencies.

functional_requirements.requirement: When empty is high and write_en is high at a rising edge, the FIFO accepts write_data and empty deasserts on the next rising edge.
When full is high and read_en is high at a rising edge, the FIFO presents the oldest stored data on read_data on the next rising edge, and full deasserts on that same next rising edge.

Simultaneous write_en and read_en when the FIFO is neither full nor empty results in both operations completing: new data is stored, oldest data is output on read_data on the next rising edge, and occupancy remains unchanged.
A write_en when full is high or a read_en when empty is high must not alter the FIFO state or output; read_data retains its previous value.

public_spec.interface:
Module name: fifo_controller
Port list (all 1-bit unless noted):
- input clk
- input rst (synchronous, active-high)
- input [7:0] write_data
- input write_en
- input read_en
- output [7:0] read_data
- output full
- output empty

Timing contract:
- All outputs are Moore type (functions of current registered state only).
- read_data: registered output. After a read is accepted (read_en high and empty low at a rising edge), the data appears on read_data on the NEXT rising edge of clk (1 cycle latency).
- full: asserts on the rising edge FOLLOWING the cycle in which the fourth write is accepted (i.e., when occupancy transitions from 3 to 4). Deasserts on the rising edge FOLLOWING the cycle in which a read is accepted when full.
- empty: asserts on the rising edge FOLLOWING the cycle in which the last entry is read (occupancy transitions from 1 to 0). Deasserts on the rising edge FOLLOWING the cycle in which a write is accepted when empty.
- Reset: synchronous active-high. When rst is high at a rising edge, the FIFO is cleared. On the NEXT rising edge after rst is released (rst low), empty is high, full is low, and read_data holds 0.
public_spec.objective: Reconstruct readable RTL for a flattened four-entry FIFO including pointer updates, full/empty flags, and registered read timing.
public_spec.response_format: Submit a single Verilog file at submission/recovered_rtl.v containing the module fifo_controller with the exact port list specified in the interface. The module must be synthesizable and match the cycle-accurate behavior described.
